title: C1.2 Unit 7 quiz — Science and change
description: O futuro no passado, o futuro próximo com nuance, explicar ideias complexas, vocabulário de energia e ciência, experience e physician.

questions.question: "The facility was to have opened in June." Quer dizer que…

options.text: estava previsto para Junho, mas não abriu nessa altura
abriu em Junho
vai abrir no próximo Junho

questions.explanation: was to have + particípio: o plano não se cumpriu.

questions.question: Escolha a frase correcta.

options.text: I knew it would be difficult.
I knew it will be difficult.
I knew it would to be difficult.

questions.explanation: would = o futuro visto do passado.

options.text: We are on the verge of finishing.
We are on the verge to finish.
We are on verge finishing.

questions.question: O horário diz que o avião aterra às seis. A melhor frase:

options.text: The plane is due to land at six.
The plane is on the verge of landing at six.
The plane is bound to landing at six.

questions.explanation: be due to = marcado num calendário.

questions.question: Qual é o melhor começo para explicar baterias a um morador?

options.text: Think of it as a water tank on your roof.
It is a sixteen-container lithium iron phosphate system.
It is too technical to explain.

questions.question: Complete: "It works a bit ___ a smoke alarm."

options.text: like
alike
like as

questions.question: "Fizemos uma experiência no laboratório." Em inglês:

options.text: We did an experiment in the lab.
We did an experience in the lab.
We made an experienced in the lab.

questions.explanation: Falso amigo: experience = experiência de vida.

options.text: She's a physicist.
She's a physician.
She's a physical.

questions.question: Complete: "The team ___ out research for five years."

options.text: carried
made
did out

questions.question: Reciclagem (C1, unidade 6). "I can't come on Friday." Também não pode. Diz:

options.text: Neither can I.
So can I.
Neither I can't.

questions.question: Reciclagem (C1, unidade 5). Escolha a frase correcta.

options.text: The batteries are said to catch fire easily.
The batteries are said that they catch fire easily.
The batteries are saying to catch fire easily.

questions.question: Reciclagem (C1, unidade 1). Escolha a frase correcta.

options.text: What the facility does is keep solar energy for the evening.
